pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

lenses.note: Bug fix with a single sensible design (escape LIKE wildcards). The change does what the PR says and nothing more.
No spec file in this change.
New tests cover %, _, mixed, and backslash literals. They would fail on the old code, where ?q=% matched everything. I couldn't run them here because vitest isn't installed (CI runs them).
The diff touches only src/index.js and test/search.test.js. I found no docs describing search.
The escape regex and ESCAPE '\' clause are consistent. The SQL string literal '\\' in JS yields '\', a single-character escape. The query is still parameterized.
The query is bound as a parameter, so there is no injection. Escaping removes the user-controlled wildcard behaviour.
The diff touches no UI files.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title and body match the diff. The PR says there are no deleted tests, and the diff deletes none.
